source.text: Καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἔχοντα τὴν κλεῖν τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ ἅλυσιν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw an angel coming down out of the heaven, having the key of the abyss and a chain great on the hand of him.

en.L: And I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
en.B: Then I saw an angel come down from heaven with the key to the abyss and a heavy chain in his hand.
en.R: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven. He had the key to the bottomless pit, and he held a big chain in his hand.

fr.L: Et je vis un ange descendre du ciel, ayant la clé de l’abîme et une grande chaîne dans sa main.
fr.B: Puis je vis un ange descendre du ciel, avec à la main la clé de l’abîme et une lourde chaîne.
fr.R: Puis j’ai vu un ange qui descendait du ciel. Il avait la clé du gouffre sans fond, et il tenait une grosse chaîne dans sa main.

sw.L: Na nikamwona malaika akishuka kutoka mbinguni, akiwa na ufunguo wa kilindi na mnyororo mkubwa mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Kisha nikamwona malaika akishuka kutoka mbinguni, akiwa na ufunguo wa kilindi na mnyororo mzito mkononi mwake.
sw.R: Kisha nikamwona malaika akishuka kutoka mbinguni. Alikuwa na ufunguo wa lile shimo lisilo na mwisho, na alishika mnyororo mkubwa mkononi mwake.

es.L: Y vi a un ángel que descendía del cielo, que tenía la llave del abismo y una gran cadena en su mano.
es.B: Luego vi a un ángel que bajaba del cielo con la llave del abismo y una gran cadena en la mano.
es.R: Luego vi a un ángel que bajaba del cielo. Tenía la llave del pozo sin fondo, y llevaba en la mano una cadena grande.

decisions.choice: an angel with the key of the abyss
decisions.reason: The abyss is the prison of evil powers (9:1-2). Satan, once thrown from heaven (12:9), is now locked away by an angel: it takes no more than one of God's messengers to bind him.

decisions.choice: abyss (L, B); bottomless pit (R)
decisions.reason: As in 9:1.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R) ("je vis" / "j’ai vu")
decisions.reason: As in chapters 12 and 17 to 19: John tells what he saw, so the passé simple serves careful written narrative and Readable uses the passé composé. What is foretold (20:7-8) is in the future at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: l’abîme (L, B); le gouffre sans fond (R)
decisions.reason: As in 17:8, following the English.

decisions.choice: el abismo (L, B); el pozo sin fondo (R)
decisions.reason: As in 9:1 and 17:8.

source.text: καὶ ἐκράτησεν τὸν δράκοντα, ὁ ὄφις ὁ ἀρχαῖος, ὅς ἐστιν Διάβολος καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς, καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν χίλια ἔτη, καὶ ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον, καὶ ἔκλεισεν καὶ ἐσφράγισεν ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ πλανήσῃ ἔτι τὰ ἔθνη, ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη· μετὰ ταῦτα δεῖ λυθῆναι αὐτὸν μικρὸν χρόνον.

records.literal_gloss: And he seized the dragon, the serpent the ancient, who is Devil and the Satan, and bound him thousand years, \v 3 and threw him into the abyss and shut and sealed over him, so that not he may deceive any longer the nations until are completed the thousand years; after these things it is necessary to be released him a little time.

en.L: And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is [the] Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years, \v 3 and threw him into the abyss, and shut and sealed [it] over him, so that he would deceive the nations no longer until the thousand years were completed; after these things he must be released for a short time.
en.B: He took hold of the dragon, the serpent of old, who is the devil and Satan, and chained him up for a thousand years. \v 3 Into the abyss he threw him, shutting it and setting a seal over him, so that he would deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were over. After that he must be let loose for a short time.
en.R: He grabbed the dragon, the ancient snake, who is the devil and Satan. He tied him up for a thousand years. \v 3 He threw him into the bottomless pit, locked it, and sealed it. Then the devil could not fool the nations anymore until the thousand years were over. After that he must be set free for a short time.

fr.L: Et il saisit le dragon, le serpent ancien, qui est [le] Diable et Satan, et il le lia pour mille ans, \v 3 et il le jeta dans l’abîme, et ferma et scella [l’entrée] au-dessus de lui, afin qu’il n’égare plus les nations jusqu’à ce que les mille ans soient achevés ; après cela, il faut qu’il soit relâché pour un peu de temps.
fr.B: Il s’empara du dragon, le serpent d’autrefois, qui est le diable et Satan, et l’enchaîna pour mille ans. \v 3 Il le jeta dans l’abîme, qu’il ferma et scella au-dessus de lui, pour qu’il n’égare plus les nations jusqu’à la fin des mille ans. Après cela, il doit être relâché pour peu de temps.
fr.R: Il a attrapé le dragon, l’ancien serpent, c’est-à-dire le diable et Satan. Il l’a attaché pour mille ans. \v 3 Il l’a jeté dans le gouffre sans fond, il l’a fermé à clé et il a mis un sceau dessus. Alors le diable ne pouvait plus tromper les nations jusqu’à la fin des mille ans. Après cela, il doit être libéré pour un peu de temps.

sw.L: Naye akamkamata yule joka, yule nyoka wa zamani, ambaye ni Ibilisi na Shetani, akamfunga kwa miaka elfu moja, \v 3 akamtupa ndani ya kilindi, akakifunga na kutia muhuri juu yake, ili asiyadanganye mataifa tena mpaka ile miaka elfu moja itimie; baada ya hayo imempasa kufunguliwa kwa muda mfupi.
sw.B: Alimkamata yule joka, yule nyoka wa zamani, ambaye ni Ibilisi na Shetani, akamfunga kwa minyororo kwa miaka elfu moja. \v 3 Akamtupa ndani ya kilindi, akakifunga na kukitia muhuri juu yake, ili asiyadanganye mataifa tena mpaka miaka elfu moja itimie. Baada ya hapo lazima afunguliwe kwa muda mfupi.
sw.R: Alimkamata yule joka, yule nyoka wa zamani, ambaye ni Ibilisi na Shetani. Akamfunga kwa miaka elfu moja. \v 3 Akamtupa ndani ya lile shimo lisilo na mwisho, akalifunga kwa ufunguo na kulitia muhuri. Hivyo Ibilisi hakuweza kuyadanganya mataifa tena mpaka miaka elfu moja itimie. Baada ya hapo lazima afunguliwe kwa muda mfupi.

es.L: Y prendió al dragón, la serpiente antigua, que es [el] Diablo y Satanás, y lo ató por mil años, \v 3 y lo arrojó al abismo, y cerró y puso un sello sobre él, para que no engañara más a las naciones hasta que se cumplieran los mil años; después de esto es necesario que sea soltado por un poco de tiempo.
es.B: Sujetó al dragón, la serpiente antigua, que es el diablo y Satanás, y lo encadenó por mil años. \v 3 Lo arrojó al abismo, lo cerró y lo selló sobre él, para que no engañara más a las naciones hasta que se cumplieran los mil años. Después de eso, tiene que ser soltado por un poco de tiempo.
es.R: Agarró al dragón, la serpiente antigua, que es el diablo y Satanás. Lo ató por mil años. \v 3 Lo arrojó al pozo sin fondo, lo cerró con llave y lo selló. Así el diablo no podría engañar más a las naciones hasta que se terminaran los mil años. Después de eso tiene que ser soltado por poco tiempo.

decisions.choice: the thousand years: how the period is understood
alternatives: a future reign of Christ on earth after his return (premillennial)
the present age between Christ's first and second comings, in which Satan is restrained and the saints reign with Christ (amillennial)
a future golden age of the gospel's success before Christ returns (postmillennial)
decisions.reason: The thousand years are mentioned only in this passage of the Bible, six times in 20:2-7. Christians have long read them in different ways. Some take them as a period after Christ's return (19:11-21) in which he reigns on earth. Others take them as a symbol of the whole time of the church, in which Satan is bound so that he cannot stop the gospel from reaching the nations (compare Mark 3:27; Matthew 28:18-20), and the faithful dead reign with Christ. Others take them as a future age of the gospel's triumph before Christ comes. A thousand, ten times ten times ten, may stand for a long and complete period. The decisions on this passage set out what the text says and do not settle the question.

decisions.choice: the dragon named and bound
decisions.reason: The dragon's names are those of 12:9. Isaiah 24:21-22 speaks of the powers of heaven and the kings of the earth being shut up in a prison and punished after many days. Jesus spoke of binding the strong man in order to plunder his house (Mark 3:27).

decisions.choice: so that he would not deceive the nations
decisions.reason: The binding has a stated purpose: to stop Satan from deceiving the nations, the work he did through the beast and false prophet (13:14; 19:20). It does not say that he is inactive in every way.

decisions.choice: he must be released: God's purpose, not Satan's escape
decisions.reason: δεῖ "must" is the word of God's set purpose (1:1). Satan's release, like his binding, is within God's plan (20:7-10).

decisions.choice: a thousand years
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the plain number; "millennium" is the later name for this period.

decisions.choice: nyoka wa zamani; Ibilisi; Shetani
decisions.reason: "Ibilisi" (the devil) and "Shetani" (Satan), as settled for the Swahili New Testament; "nyoka wa zamani" (the serpent of old) points back to Genesis 3 (m2).

decisions.choice: miaka elfu moja (in words)
decisions.reason: The thousand years are written in words, as numbers in running text are; unlike the 144,000 of chapter 7, "elfu moja" is short and recurs as a name for the period (m1).

decisions.choice: la serpiente antigua; [el] Diablo (L), el diablo (B, R); Satanás
decisions.reason: The names as settled in 12:9.

decisions.choice: mil años
decisions.reason: Spanish says "mil años" at every level, as the Greek does, and does not use the later term "milenio", which would name a doctrine; the meaning decision sets out how the period is understood.

source.text: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνους, καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐπ’ αὐτούς, καὶ κρίμα ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν πεπελεκισμένων διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ καὶ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ οἵτινες οὐ προσεκύνησαν τὸ θηρίον οὐδὲ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔλαβον τὸ χάραγμα ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔζησαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν μετὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ χίλια ἔτη.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them, and the souls of those having been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of the God, and who not worshiped the beast nor the image of it and not received the mark on the forehead and on the hand of them; and they lived and reigned with the Christ thousand years.

en.L: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them, and the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand; and they came to life and reigned with the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} a thousand years.
en.B: I saw thrones, and people seated on them who were given the right to judge. I saw too the souls of those beheaded for holding to the testimony of Jesus and the word of God, those who had refused to worship the beast or its image and had not let its mark be put on forehead or hand. They came to life and reigned with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} for a thousand years.
en.R: Then I saw thrones. The people sitting on them were given power to judge. I also saw the souls of people whose heads had been cut off because they told the truth about Jesus and God's message. They had not worshiped the beast or its statue. They had not let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They came back to life and ruled with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} for a thousand years.

fr.L: Et je vis des trônes, et ils s’assirent dessus, et un jugement leur fut donné, et les âmes de ceux qui avaient été décapités à cause du témoignage de Jésus et à cause de la parole de Dieu, et qui n’avaient pas adoré la bête ni son image, et n’avaient pas reçu la marque sur leur front et sur leur main ; et ils revinrent à la vie et régnèrent avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} mille ans.
fr.B: Je vis des trônes, et des gens assis dessus, à qui fut donné le pouvoir de juger. Je vis aussi les âmes de ceux qui avaient été décapités pour avoir tenu au témoignage de Jésus et à la parole de Dieu, ceux qui avaient refusé d’adorer la bête et son image et ne s’étaient pas laissé mettre sa marque sur le front ou sur la main. Ils revinrent à la vie et régnèrent avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pendant mille ans.
fr.R: Puis j’ai vu des trônes. Les gens qui étaient assis dessus ont reçu le pouvoir de juger. J’ai vu aussi les âmes des gens à qui on avait coupé la tête parce qu’ils avaient dit la vérité sur Jésus et sur le message de Dieu. Ils n’avaient pas adoré la bête ni sa statue. Ils ne s’étaient pas laissé mettre sa marque sur le front ou sur la main. Ils sont revenus à la vie et ils ont régné avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pendant mille ans.

sw.L: Na nikaona viti vya enzi, nao wakaketi juu yake, na hukumu wakapewa, na nafsi za wale waliokatwa vichwa kwa sababu ya ushuhuda wa Yesu na kwa sababu ya neno la Mungu, na ambao hawakumsujudia mnyama wala sanamu yake, wala hawakupokea alama juu ya vipaji vya nyuso zao na juu ya mikono yao; nao wakawa hai, wakatawala pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} miaka elfu moja.
sw.B: Nikaona viti vya enzi, na watu wameketi juu yake waliopewa mamlaka ya kuhukumu. Nikaona pia roho za wale waliokatwa vichwa kwa sababu ya kushika ushuhuda wa Yesu na neno la Mungu, wale waliokataa kumsujudia mnyama au sanamu yake, wala hawakukubali kutiwa alama yake kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao au kwenye mikono yao. Hao walifufuka, wakatawala pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa miaka elfu moja.
sw.R: Kisha nikaona viti vya enzi. Watu walioketi juu yake walipewa mamlaka ya kuhukumu. Nikaona pia roho za watu waliokatwa vichwa kwa sababu walisema ukweli kuhusu Yesu na ujumbe wa Mungu. Hawakuwa wamemwabudu mnyama wala sanamu yake. Hawakukubali kutiwa alama yake kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao wala kwenye mikono yao. Walifufuka, wakatawala pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa miaka elfu moja.

es.L: Y vi tronos, y se sentaron sobre ellos, y se les dio [el poder de] juzgar; y [vi] las almas de los que habían sido decapitados por causa del testimonio de Jesús y por causa de la palabra de Dios, y que no habían adorado a la bestia ni a su imagen, y no habían recibido la marca en su frente ni en su mano; y vivieron y reinaron con el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} mil años.
es.B: Vi tronos, y en ellos se sentaron los que recibieron autoridad para juzgar. Vi también las almas de los que habían sido decapitados por mantenerse fieles al testimonio de Jesús y a la palabra de Dios, los que no habían adorado a la bestia ni a su imagen, ni se habían dejado poner su marca en la frente ni en la mano. Volvieron a vivir y reinaron con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} durante mil años.
es.R: Luego vi tronos. A los que estaban sentados en ellos se les dio poder para juzgar. También vi las almas de las personas a las que habían cortado la cabeza porque decían la verdad acerca de Jesús y anunciaban el mensaje de Dios. No habían adorado a la bestia ni a su estatua. No se habían dejado poner su marca en la frente ni en la mano. Volvieron a la vida y gobernaron con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} durante mil años.

decisions.choice: thrones and judgment given: Daniel 7
decisions.reason: Daniel saw thrones set in place, and "judgment was given for the saints of the Most High, and the time came when the saints possessed the kingdom" (Daniel 7:9, 22). Jesus promised the Twelve thrones (Matthew 19:28), and the one who overcomes shares Christ's throne (3:21). Who sits on these thrones is not said: the martyrs, all the faithful, or the elders.

decisions.choice: they came to life: the first resurrection
alternatives: the life of the faithful dead with Christ in heaven before the final resurrection
the new life of believers now
decisions.reason: ἔζησαν is the verb used of Christ's resurrection (2:8). Verse 5 calls this "the first resurrection". Some take it as a bodily raising of the faithful when Christ returns, before the rest of the dead; others as the life the faithful dead share with Christ while they await the final resurrection; others as believers' present new life in Christ. The text does not settle which.

decisions.choice: beheaded: executed with the axe
decisions.reason: πεπελεκισμένων means beheaded with an axe, a Roman form of execution. It stands for all who were killed for their faithfulness.

decisions.choice: Christ | the Messiah
decisions.reason: As the style guide requires.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} at every level, here and in 20:6 ("du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}")
decisions.reason: As the style guide: the article stays outside the span, because both "le Christ" and "le Messie" read naturally in French, so Literal and the other levels have the same form.

decisions.choice: nafsi (L); roho (B, R); wakawa hai (L), walifufuka (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:9, Literal keeps "nafsi" and Balanced and Readable say "roho" for the persons themselves (m3). Literal says "wakawa hai" (they came to life) for the Greek verb; Balanced and Readable say "walifufuka" (they rose), which links it with "ufufuo" in 20:5.

decisions.choice: decapitados (L, B); les habían cortado la cabeza (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word names execution with the axe, as the meaning decision says; Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: vivieron (L); volvieron a vivir (B); volvieron a la vida (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says simply "they lived"; Literal keeps that, and Balanced and Readable say they came to life, as the English does, without the word "resucitar", which the text keeps for the noun in 20:5.

source.text: οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔζησαν ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη.

records.literal_gloss: The rest of the dead not lived until are completed the thousand years.

en.L: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed.
en.B: The other dead did not live again until the thousand years were completed.
en.R: The rest of the dead people did not come back to life until the thousand years were over.

fr.L: Le reste des morts ne revint pas à la vie jusqu’à ce que les mille ans soient achevés.
fr.B: Les autres morts ne revécurent pas avant la fin des mille ans.
fr.R: Les autres morts ne sont pas revenus à la vie avant la fin des mille ans.

sw.L: Wafu waliobaki hawakuwa hai mpaka ile miaka elfu moja itimie.
sw.B: Wafu wengine hawakufufuka mpaka miaka elfu moja ilipotimia.
sw.R: Wafu wengine hawakufufuka mpaka miaka elfu moja ilipokwisha.

es.L: Los demás muertos no vivieron hasta que se cumplieron los mil años.
es.B: Los demás muertos no volvieron a vivir hasta que se cumplieron los mil años.
es.R: Los demás muertos no volvieron a la vida hasta que se terminaron los mil años.

decisions.choice: the rest of the dead: those not raised in the first resurrection
decisions.reason: The rest come to life for the judgment of 20:12-13. On how the sequence is understood, see the notes on 20:2 and 20:4.

en.R: Coming back to life in this way is called the first resurrection.

fr.R: Revenir ainsi à la vie, c’est ce qu’on appelle la première résurrection.

sw.R: Kufufuka huko kunaitwa ufufuo wa kwanza.

es.R: Volver a la vida de esta manera se llama la primera resurrección.

decisions.choice: this: the coming to life of 20:4
decisions.reason: "This" refers back past the remark about the rest of the dead to those who came to life and reigned with Christ (20:4). See the note there.

source.text: μακάριος καὶ ἅγιος ὁ ἔχων μέρος ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῇ πρώτῃ· ἐπὶ τούτων ὁ δεύτερος θάνατος οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλ’ ἔσονται ἱερεῖς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ χριστοῦ, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν μετ’ αὐτοῦ χίλια ἔτη.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed and holy the [one] having part in the resurrection the first; over these the second death not has authority, but they will be priests of the God and of the Christ, and they will reign with him thousand years.

en.L: Blessed and holy [is] the one who has a part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and they will reign with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a thousand years.
en.B: Blessed and holy is anyone who has a share in the first resurrection! Over such people the second death has no power; they will serve as priests of God and of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and they will reign with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a thousand years.
en.R: God blesses the people who are part of the first resurrection. They are holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests who serve God and {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. They will rule with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for a thousand years.

fr.L: Heureux et saint celui qui a part à la première résurrection ; sur ceux-là la seconde mort n’a pas d’autorité, mais ils seront prêtres de Dieu et du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et ils régneront avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} mille ans.
fr.B: Heureux et saint quiconque a part à la première résurrection ! Sur eux la seconde mort n’a aucun pouvoir ; ils seront prêtres de Dieu et du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et ils régneront avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pendant mille ans.
fr.R: Dieu bénit ceux qui ont part à la première résurrection. Ils sont saints. La seconde mort n’a aucun pouvoir sur eux. Ils seront des prêtres au service de Dieu et du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Ils régneront avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pendant mille ans.

sw.L: Heri na mtakatifu aliye na sehemu katika ufufuo wa kwanza; juu ya hawa kifo cha pili hakina mamlaka, bali watakuwa makuhani wa Mungu na wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, nao watatawala pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} miaka elfu moja.
sw.B: Heri na mtakatifu ni kila aliye na sehemu katika ufufuo wa kwanza! Kifo cha pili hakina mamlaka juu yao; watakuwa makuhani wa Mungu na wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, nao watatawala pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa miaka elfu moja.
sw.R: Mungu huwabariki watu walio sehemu ya ufufuo wa kwanza. Wao ni watakatifu. Kifo cha pili hakina nguvu juu yao. Watakuwa makuhani wanaomtumikia Mungu na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Watatawala pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa miaka elfu moja.

es.L: Dichoso y santo el que tiene parte en la primera resurrección; sobre estos la segunda muerte no tiene autoridad, sino que serán sacerdotes de Dios y del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, y reinarán con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mil años.
es.B: ¡Dichoso y santo el que tiene parte en la primera resurrección! Sobre ellos la segunda muerte no tiene ningún poder; serán sacerdotes de Dios y {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y reinarán con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mil años.
es.R: Dios bendice a los que forman parte de la primera resurrección. Son santos. La segunda muerte no tiene ningún poder sobre ellos. Serán sacerdotes que sirven a Dios y {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. Gobernarán con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} durante mil años.

decisions.choice: the fifth blessing
decisions.reason: This is the fifth of the book's seven blessings (1:3).

decisions.choice: the second death
decisions.reason: See 2:11 and 20:14: the lake of fire, the final judgment. Those who share in the first resurrection are safe from it.

decisions.choice: priests and kings with Christ
decisions.reason: The promise of 1:6 and 5:10 is fulfilled: God's people serve as priests and reign. Priests "of God and of Christ" again places Christ with God.

decisions.choice: God blesses (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:3.

decisions.choice: Dichoso (L, B); Dios bendice a (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the blessings of the book, as in 1:3 and 14:13.

source.text: Καὶ ὅταν τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη, λυθήσεται ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐκ τῆς φυλακῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξελεύσεται πλανῆσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐν ταῖς τέσσαρσι γωνίαις τῆς γῆς, τὸν Γὼγ καὶ Μαγώγ, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον, ὧν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης.

records.literal_gloss: And when are completed the thousand years, will be released the Satan out of the prison of him, \v 8 and will go out to deceive the nations the in the four corners of the earth, the Gog and Magog, to gather them into the war, of whom the number of them as the sand of the sea.

en.L: And when the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison \v 8 and will go out to deceive the nations that are at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for the war; their number [is] like the sand of the sea.
en.B: Once the thousand years are completed, Satan will be freed from his prison \v 8 and will go out to deceive the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and to muster them for war, countless as the sand of the sea.
en.R: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be let out of his prison. \v 8 He will go out to fool the nations all over the world, called Gog and Magog. He will gather them together for war. There will be as many of them as there are grains of sand on the seashore.

fr.L: Et quand les mille ans seront achevés, Satan sera relâché de sa prison \v 8 et il sortira pour égarer les nations qui sont aux quatre coins de la terre, Gog et Magog, afin de les rassembler pour la guerre ; leur nombre [est] comme le sable de la mer.
fr.B: Lorsque les mille ans seront achevés, Satan sera libéré de sa prison \v 8 et il sortira pour égarer les nations aux quatre coins de la terre, Gog et Magog, et les rassembler pour la guerre, innombrables comme le sable de la mer.
fr.R: Quand les mille ans seront finis, Satan sera libéré de sa prison. \v 8 Il sortira pour tromper les nations du monde entier, qu’on appelle Gog et Magog. Il les rassemblera pour la guerre. Elles seront aussi nombreuses que les grains de sable au bord de la mer.

sw.L: Na miaka elfu moja itakapotimia, Shetani atafunguliwa kutoka katika gereza lake, \v 8 naye atatoka kwenda kuyadanganya mataifa yaliyo katika pembe nne za dunia, Gogu na Magogu, ili kuwakusanya kwa ajili ya vita; idadi yao [ni] kama mchanga wa bahari.
sw.B: Miaka elfu moja itakapotimia, Shetani atafunguliwa kutoka gerezani mwake, \v 8 naye atatoka kwenda kuyadanganya mataifa yaliyo katika pembe nne za dunia, Gogu na Magogu, na kuwakusanya kwa ajili ya vita; wengi wasiohesabika kama mchanga wa bahari.
sw.R: Miaka elfu moja itakapokwisha, Shetani atafunguliwa kutoka gerezani mwake. \v 8 Atatoka kwenda kuyadanganya mataifa ya dunia nzima, yanayoitwa Gogu na Magogu. Atayakusanya kwa ajili ya vita. Watakuwa wengi kama chembe za mchanga ufuoni mwa bahari.

es.L: Y cuando se cumplan los mil años, Satanás será soltado de su prisión \v 8 y saldrá a engañar a las naciones que [están] en los cuatro ángulos de la tierra, a Gog y a Magog, para reunirlos para la guerra; su número [es] como la arena del mar.
es.B: Cuando se cumplan los mil años, Satanás será liberado de su prisión \v 8 y saldrá a engañar a las naciones de los cuatro extremos de la tierra, a Gog y a Magog, para reunirlas para la guerra. Serán tan numerosas como la arena del mar.
es.R: Cuando se terminen los mil años, Satanás será soltado de su prisión. \v 8 Saldrá a engañar a las naciones de todo el mundo, llamadas Gog y Magog. Las reunirá para la guerra. Serán tantas como los granos de arena a la orilla del mar.

decisions.choice: Gog and Magog: Ezekiel 38-39
decisions.reason: Ezekiel foretold an attack on God's restored people by "Gog, of the land of Magog" and many nations, ended by God's fire from heaven (Ezekiel 38-39). Here Gog and Magog are the names of the nations from the four corners of the earth: all the world's forces gathered against God's people.

decisions.choice: the war: perhaps the same battle as in 16:14 and 19:19
decisions.reason: The article, "the war", recalls the battle of 16:14 and 19:19, and both draw on Ezekiel 38-39. Readers who take the thousand years as the church age often see 19:17-21 and 20:7-10 as the same final battle told twice; others as two battles.

decisions.choice: Gogu na Magogu
decisions.reason: The names from Ezekiel 38-39 (m1) with the Swahili final vowel, as Swahili gives Hebrew names ("Yakobo", "Daudi").

decisions.choice: ángulos (L); extremos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:1.

decisions.choice: reunirlos
decisions.reason: The Greek pronoun is masculine, thinking of the people rather than the word "nations"; Literal follows it, Balanced and Readable agree with "naciones".

source.text: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸ πλάτος τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἐκύκλευσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἠγαπημένην.

records.literal_gloss: And they went up over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the city the having been loved.

en.L: And they went up over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
en.B: Up they came across the whole width of the earth and encircled the camp of God's holy people and the beloved city.
en.R: They marched across the whole earth. They surrounded the camp of God's people and the city God loves.

fr.L: Et ils montèrent sur la largeur de la terre et encerclèrent le camp des saints et la ville bien-aimée.
fr.B: Ils se répandirent sur toute l’étendue de la terre et encerclèrent le camp du peuple saint de Dieu et la ville bien-aimée.
fr.R: Ils ont traversé toute la terre. Ils ont encerclé le camp du peuple de Dieu et la ville que Dieu aime.

sw.L: Nao wakapanda juu ya upana wa dunia, wakaizunguka kambi ya watakatifu na mji ule uliopendwa.
sw.B: Walipanda wakipita katika upana wote wa dunia, wakaizingira kambi ya watu watakatifu wa Mungu na mji ule unaopendwa.
sw.R: Walitembea katika dunia nzima. Waliizingira kambi ya watu wa Mungu na mji ambao Mungu anaupenda.

es.L: Y subieron sobre la anchura de la tierra y rodearon el campamento de los santos y la ciudad amada.
es.B: Subieron por toda la anchura de la tierra y cercaron el campamento del pueblo santo de Dios y la ciudad amada.
es.R: Marcharon por toda la tierra. Rodearon el campamento del pueblo de Dios y la ciudad que Dios ama.

decisions.choice: the camp of the saints and the beloved city: God's people
decisions.reason: The camp recalls Israel encamped in the wilderness; the beloved city is Zion, which God loves (Psalm 78:68; 87:2). Both describe God's people, gathered and besieged.

decisions.choice: saints (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:8.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); le peuple saint de Dieu (B); le peuple de Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 17:6 and the style guide's term for the whole New Testament.

source.text: καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς·

records.literal_gloss: And came down fire out of the heaven and devoured them.

en.L: And fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
en.B: Then fire fell from heaven and burned them up.
en.R: But fire came down from heaven and destroyed them.

fr.L: Et un feu descendit du ciel et les dévora.
fr.B: Alors un feu tomba du ciel et les consuma.
fr.R: Mais un feu est descendu du ciel et les a détruits.

sw.L: Na moto ukashuka kutoka mbinguni ukawala.
sw.B: Lakini moto ukashuka kutoka mbinguni ukawateketeza.
sw.R: Lakini moto ulishuka kutoka mbinguni ukawaangamiza.

es.L: Y descendió fuego del cielo y los devoró.
es.B: Pero cayó fuego del cielo y los consumió.
es.R: Pero bajó fuego del cielo y los destruyó.

decisions.choice: fire from heaven: Ezekiel 38-39
decisions.reason: "I will rain upon him ... fire and sulfur" (Ezekiel 38:22; 39:6). No battle is fought; God ends the siege.

source.text: καὶ ὁ διάβολος ὁ πλανῶν αὐτοὺς ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ θείου, ὅπου καὶ τὸ θηρίον καὶ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης, καὶ βασανισθήσονται ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

records.literal_gloss: And the devil the [one] deceiving them was thrown into the lake of the fire and sulfur, where also the beast and the false prophet, and they will be tormented day and night into the ages of the ages.

en.L: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet also [are], and they will be tormented day and night for the ages of the ages.
en.B: Then the devil, their deceiver, was cast into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are as well; and day and night, forever and ever, they will suffer torment.
en.R: The devil, who had fooled them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur. The beast and the false prophet were already there. They will suffer day and night forever and ever.

fr.L: Et le diable qui les égarait fut jeté dans le lac de feu et de soufre, où [sont] aussi la bête et le faux prophète, et ils seront tourmentés jour et nuit aux siècles des siècles.
fr.B: Puis le diable, qui les avait égarés, fut jeté dans le lac de feu et de soufre, où se trouvent aussi la bête et le faux prophète ; et jour et nuit, pour toujours et à jamais, ils subiront le tourment.
fr.R: Le diable, qui les avait trompés, a été jeté dans le lac de soufre brûlant. La bête et le faux prophète y étaient déjà. Ils souffriront jour et nuit, pour toujours.

sw.L: Na Ibilisi aliyewadanganya akatupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto na kiberiti, ambamo pia [wamo] yule mnyama na yule nabii wa uongo, nao watateswa mchana na usiku hata zama za zama.
sw.B: Kisha Ibilisi, aliyewadanganya, akatupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto na kiberiti, ambamo pia yule mnyama na yule nabii wa uongo wamo; nao watateswa mchana na usiku milele na milele.
sw.R: Ibilisi, aliyekuwa amewadanganya, alitupwa ndani ya ziwa la kiberiti kinachowaka moto. Mnyama na nabii wa uongo walikuwa tayari humo. Watateseka mchana na usiku milele na milele.

es.L: Y el diablo, que los engañaba, fue arrojado al lago de fuego y azufre, donde también [están] la bestia y el falso profeta, y serán atormentados día y noche por los siglos de los siglos.
es.B: Y el diablo, que los había engañado, fue arrojado al lago de fuego y azufre, donde también están la bestia y el falso profeta; y serán atormentados día y noche por los siglos de los siglos.
es.R: El diablo, que los había engañado, fue arrojado al lago de fuego y azufre. La bestia y el falso profeta ya estaban allí. Sufrirán día y noche para siempre.

decisions.choice: the end of the deceiver
decisions.reason: The devil joins the beast and false prophet (19:20). Jesus spoke of "the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels" (Matthew 25:41). On how Christians have understood this language, see the note on 14:10.

source.text: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνον μέγαν λευκὸν καὶ τὸν καθήμενον ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, οὗ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου ἔφυγεν ἡ γῆ καὶ ὁ οὐρανός, καὶ τόπος οὐχ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw a throne great white and the [one] sitting on it, from whose face fled the earth and the heaven, and place not was found for them.

en.L: And I saw a great white throne and the one seated on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled, and no place was found for them.
en.B: Next I saw a great white throne, and the one who sat on it; from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face earth and sky ran away, and no place could be found for them.
en.R: Then I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The earth and the sky ran away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and they disappeared.

fr.L: Et je vis un grand trône blanc et celui qui y siège, devant la face duquel s’enfuirent la terre et le ciel, et il ne se trouva pas de place pour eux.
fr.B: Ensuite je vis un grand trône blanc, et celui qui y siégeait ; devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face, la terre et le ciel s’enfuirent, et on ne trouva plus de place pour eux.
fr.R: Puis j’ai vu un grand trône blanc et celui qui était assis dessus. La terre et le ciel se sont enfuis loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et ils ont disparu.

sw.L: Na nikaona kiti cha enzi kikubwa cheupe na yule aliyeketi juu yake, ambaye nchi na mbingu zilikimbia kutoka mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wala mahali pao hapakuonekana.
sw.B: Kisha nikaona kiti cha enzi kikubwa cheupe, na yule aliyeketi juu yake; nchi na mbingu zilikimbia mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wala hapakuonekana mahali pa kuwa kwao.
sw.R: Kisha nikaona kiti cha enzi kikubwa cheupe na yule aliyeketi juu yake. Nchi na anga vilimkimbia, vikatoweka kabisa.

es.L: Y vi un gran trono blanco y al que estaba sentado sobre él, de cuya presencia huyeron la tierra y el cielo, y no se halló lugar para ellos.
es.B: Luego vi un gran trono blanco y al que estaba sentado en él. De {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia huyeron la tierra y el cielo, y no se halló lugar para ellos.
es.R: Luego vi un gran trono blanco y al que estaba sentado en él. La tierra y el cielo huyeron de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia y desaparecieron.

decisions.choice: a great white throne and the one seated on it: God the judge
alternatives: Christ, to whom the Father has given all judgment (John 5:22)
decisions.reason: Throughout Revelation "the one seated on the throne" is God (4:2; 5:1). Elsewhere the New Testament speaks of Christ as judge (Matthew 25:31; 2 Corinthians 5:10), and in Revelation the throne is God's and the Lamb's (22:1). White speaks of holiness and pure justice (Daniel 7:9).

decisions.choice: earth and sky flee: the old creation gives way
decisions.reason: The heavens and earth wear out and are changed (Psalm 102:26-27; Isaiah 51:6; 2 Peter 3:10). No place is found for them (compare 12:8; 16:20). The new heaven and earth follow (21:1).

decisions.choice: de cuya presencia
decisions.reason: "From whose face" is a Hebrew way of saying from his presence; Spanish says "presencia" at every level, and "cuya" needs no span.

source.text: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς νεκρούς, τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ τοὺς μικρούς, ἑστῶτας ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ βιβλία ἠνοίχθησαν· καὶ ἄλλο βιβλίον ἠνοίχθη, ὅ ἐστιν τῆς ζωῆς· καὶ ἐκρίθησαν οἱ νεκροὶ ἐκ τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened; and another book was opened, which is of the life; and were judged the dead out of the things having been written in the books according to the works of them.

en.L: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened; and another book was opened, which is [the book] of life; and the dead were judged by the things written in the books, according to their works.
en.B: I saw the dead, the great and the lowly, standing in front of the throne. Books were opened, and so was another book, the book of life, and the dead were judged on the basis of what the books recorded, according to their deeds.
en.R: I saw all the people who had died, important and unimportant, standing in front of the throne. Some books were opened. Then another book was opened. It was the book of life. The dead were judged by what they had done, as it was written in the books.

fr.L: Et je vis les morts, les grands et les petits, debout devant le trône, et des livres furent ouverts ; et un autre livre fut ouvert, qui est [celui] de la vie ; et les morts furent jugés d’après ce qui était écrit dans les livres, selon leurs œuvres.
fr.B: Je vis les morts, les grands et les petits, debout devant le trône. Des livres furent ouverts, et un autre livre aussi, le livre de vie ; et les morts furent jugés d’après ce que contenaient les livres, selon leurs actes.
fr.R: J’ai vu tous les gens qui étaient morts, les gens importants et les gens sans importance, debout devant le trône. Des livres ont été ouverts. Puis un autre livre a été ouvert : c’était le livre de vie. Les morts ont été jugés d’après ce qu’ils avaient fait, comme c’était écrit dans les livres.

sw.L: Na nikawaona wafu, wakubwa na wadogo, wamesimama mbele ya kiti cha enzi, na vitabu vikafunguliwa; na kitabu kingine kikafunguliwa, ambacho ni [kitabu] cha uzima; na wafu wakahukumiwa kutokana na mambo yaliyoandikwa katika vitabu, kulingana na matendo yao.
sw.B: Nikawaona wafu, wakubwa na wadogo, wamesimama mbele ya kiti cha enzi. Vitabu vilifunguliwa, na kitabu kingine pia kikafunguliwa, yaani kitabu cha uzima. Wafu wakahukumiwa kwa yale yaliyoandikwa katika vitabu, kulingana na matendo yao.
sw.R: Niliwaona watu wote waliokufa, watu muhimu na watu wa kawaida, wamesimama mbele ya kiti cha enzi. Vitabu vilifunguliwa. Kisha kitabu kingine kikafunguliwa. Kilikuwa kitabu cha uzima. Wafu walihukumiwa kwa yale waliyoyatenda, kama yalivyoandikwa katika vitabu.

es.L: Y vi a los muertos, los grandes y los pequeños, de pie delante del trono, y se abrieron libros; y se abrió otro libro, que es [el libro] de la vida; y los muertos fueron juzgados por las cosas escritas en los libros, según sus obras.
es.B: Vi a los muertos, grandes y pequeños, de pie delante del trono. Se abrieron unos libros, y también se abrió otro libro, el libro de la vida; y los muertos fueron juzgados por lo que estaba escrito en los libros, según lo que habían hecho.
es.R: Vi a todos los que habían muerto, importantes y sencillos, de pie delante del trono. Se abrieron unos libros. Luego se abrió otro libro. Era el libro de la vida. Los muertos fueron juzgados por lo que habían hecho, según estaba escrito en los libros.

decisions.choice: the books opened: Daniel 7:10
decisions.reason: "The court sat in judgment, and the books were opened" (Daniel 7:10). The books record what people have done (compare Psalm 56:9; Malachi 3:16).

decisions.choice: judged by works, and the book of life
decisions.reason: Everyone is judged according to their deeds (Psalm 62:13; Romans 2:6; 2 Corinthians 5:10). Alongside the books of deeds is the book of life, the Lamb's book (13:8; 21:27), in which those who belong to him are written. Judgment by works and salvation by the Lamb stand side by side, as in 7:14 and 19:8.

source.text: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ θάλασσα τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἔδωκαν τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκρίθησαν ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And gave the sea the dead the in it, and the Death and the Hades gave the dead the in them, and they were judged each according to the works of them.

en.L: And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them, and they were judged, each one according to their works.
en.B: The sea handed over its dead, and Death and Hades handed over theirs, and they were judged, every one of them, by their works.
en.R: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it. Death and the place of the dead gave up the dead people who were in them. Each person was judged by what they had done.

fr.L: Et la mer rendit les morts qui étaient en elle, et la Mort et l’Hadès rendirent les morts qui étaient en eux, et ils furent jugés, chacun selon ses œuvres.
fr.B: La mer rendit ses morts, la Mort et le séjour des morts rendirent les leurs, et ils furent jugés, chacun selon ses œuvres.
fr.R: La mer a rendu les morts qui étaient en elle. La Mort et le séjour des morts ont rendu les morts qui étaient chez eux. Chacun a été jugé d’après ce qu’il avait fait.

sw.L: Na bahari ikawatoa wafu waliokuwa ndani yake, na Kifo na Kuzimu vikawatoa wafu waliokuwa ndani yake, nao wakahukumiwa kila mmoja kulingana na matendo yao.
sw.B: Bahari iliwatoa wafu wake, na Kifo na Kuzimu vikawatoa wafu wao, nao wakahukumiwa kila mmoja kwa matendo yake.
sw.R: Bahari iliwatoa watu waliokufa ndani yake. Kifo na Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu, vikawatoa wafu waliokuwa ndani yake. Kila mtu alihukumiwa kwa yale aliyoyatenda.

es.L: Y el mar entregó a los muertos que [había] en él, y la Muerte y el Hades entregaron a los muertos que [había] en ellos, y fueron juzgados, cada uno según sus obras.
es.B: El mar entregó a sus muertos, y la Muerte y el Hades entregaron a los suyos, y cada uno fue juzgado según lo que había hecho.
es.R: El mar devolvió a los muertos que había en él. La Muerte y el lugar de los muertos devolvieron a los muertos que había en ellos. Cada persona fue juzgada según lo que había hecho.

decisions.choice: all the dead, wherever they are
decisions.reason: The sea held those lost without burial; Death and Hades hold the rest. No one is beyond the reach of God's call to judgment (John 5:28-29).

decisions.choice: Hades (L, B); the place of the dead (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:18.

decisions.choice: l’Hadès (L); le séjour des morts (B, R), here and in 20:14
alternatives: l’Hadès at Balanced, as the English keeps "Hades"
decisions.reason: The style guide's term for the whole New Testament: French readers rarely know the Greek name, so Balanced already says what it is, as Readable does in English. "La Mort" keeps its capital at every level, since it is paired with the place as a power (m1).

decisions.choice: Kifo na Kuzimu (L, B); Kifo na Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:18 and 6:8: "Kifo" capitalised as a power, and "Kuzimu" for Hades, with Readable adding "mahali pa wafu" (the place of the dead). "Matendo yake" in Balanced means his or her deeds, so no gender wording is needed.

decisions.choice: la Muerte y el Hades (L, B); la Muerte y el lugar de los muertos (R)
decisions.reason: Death and Hades are named here as powers, as in 6:8, so "Muerte" is capitalised; Hades follows the settled steps.

source.text: καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἐβλήθησαν εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός.

records.literal_gloss: And the Death and the Hades were thrown into the lake of the fire.

en.L: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire.
en.B: Then Death and Hades themselves were cast into the lake of fire.
en.R: Then Death and the place of the dead were thrown into the lake of fire.

fr.L: Et la Mort et l’Hadès furent jetés dans le lac de feu.
fr.B: Puis la Mort et le séjour des morts furent eux-mêmes jetés dans le lac de feu.
fr.R: Ensuite, la Mort et le séjour des morts ont été jetés dans le lac de feu.

sw.L: Na Kifo na Kuzimu vikatupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.
sw.B: Kisha Kifo na Kuzimu vyenyewe vikatupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.
sw.R: Kisha Kifo na Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu, vikatupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.

es.L: Y la Muerte y el Hades fueron arrojados al lago de fuego.
es.B: Entonces la Muerte y el Hades mismos fueron arrojados al lago de fuego.
es.R: Luego la Muerte y el lugar de los muertos fueron arrojados al lago de fuego.

decisions.choice: death itself destroyed
decisions.reason: "The last enemy to be destroyed is death" (1 Corinthians 15:26; compare Isaiah 25:8). In the new creation there is no more death (21:4).

source.text: οὗτος ὁ θάνατος ὁ δεύτερός ἐστιν, ἡ λίμνη τοῦ πυρός.

records.literal_gloss: This the death the second is, the lake of the fire.

en.L: This is the second death, the lake of fire.
en.B: The lake of fire is the second death.
en.R: The lake of fire is the second death.

fr.L: Ceci est la seconde mort, le lac de feu.
fr.B: Le lac de feu, c’est la seconde mort.
fr.R: Le lac de feu est la seconde mort.

sw.L: Hiki ndicho kifo cha pili, ziwa la moto.
sw.B: Ziwa la moto ndilo kifo cha pili.
sw.R: Ziwa la moto ndilo kifo cha pili.

es.L: Esta es la segunda muerte, el lago de fuego.
es.B: El lago de fuego es la segunda muerte.
es.R: El lago de fuego es la segunda muerte.

decisions.choice: the second death: the lake of fire
decisions.reason: The phrase used in 2:11 and 20:6 is now explained: the second death is final separation from God in judgment (21:8).

source.text: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ τῆς ζωῆς γεγραμμένος, ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός.

records.literal_gloss: And if anyone not was found in the book of the life having been written, he was thrown into the lake of the fire.

en.L: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, {{gender:that person|he}} was thrown into the lake of fire.
en.B: And whoever was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
en.R: Everyone whose name was not written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

fr.L: Et si quelqu’un ne fut pas trouvé inscrit dans le livre de la vie, il fut jeté dans le lac de feu.
fr.B: Et quiconque ne fut pas trouvé inscrit dans le livre de vie fut jeté dans le lac de feu.
fr.R: Tous ceux dont le nom n’était pas écrit dans le livre de vie ont été jetés dans le lac de feu.

sw.L: Na ikiwa mtu yeyote hakuonekana ameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima, alitupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.
sw.B: Na kila ambaye hakuonekana ameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima alitupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.
sw.R: Kila mtu ambaye jina lake halikuandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima alitupwa ndani ya ziwa la moto.

es.L: Y si alguno no fue hallado escrito en el libro de la vida, fue arrojado al lago de fuego.
es.B: Todo aquel que no fue hallado inscrito en el libro de la vida fue arrojado al lago de fuego.
es.R: Todos los que no tenían su nombre escrito en el libro de la vida fueron arrojados al lago de fuego.

decisions.choice: the book of life decides
decisions.reason: What finally decides a person's end is whether they are written in the Lamb's book of life (3:5; 13:8; 21:27). On how Christians have understood the lake of fire, see the note on 14:10.

decisions.choice: "si quelqu’un … il" with no gender span (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a setting for the pronoun. In French "quelqu’un" already means anyone, and the "il" that refers back to it is ordinary generic French, so the style guide puts no span on it.

decisions.choice: mtu yeyote ... alitupwa, no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: "Mtu yeyote" and the verb prefix "a-" already mean any person, man or woman, so the English span "that person|he" has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: alguno ... fue arrojado (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Spanish needs no pronoun here, and "alguno" is the generic form, as in 14:9, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.
